carried_followups.text: vss is a required signal alongside the supplies; this round carries it in every new extraction and observation list
the ideal iprobe two-terminal check uses 1e-06 V plus 1e-09 times the magnitude, is proven readable in this machine export precision, and is not a device drop spec

evidence_gaps: R004 carries no trace digest in the RTL account because it was settled before the vcd column was fixed
the two stray launches left no raw bytes behind and their first log was overwritten; no number from them is published
the raws and guest logs stay on this machine; digests and local paths are published in provenance.json

gates.name: the record stage starts no simulator: the launch account is unchanged after it
every approved case has a published row table
the prepared PAM cases publish exactly the frozen emission window count
the two joint cases publish the emission windows their own enable waveforms declare
every published table re-reads at its header width on every line
the black windows are the declared zero-code and post-fault regions
no black window invents a T50 and every one carries a zero target
every black window names the function that declared its boundary
each published row is bound to a confirmed launch of the delivered deck
the meter witness passed for all nine meters before their DUT ran
the three declared convergence pairs are computed with matching context
the convergence verdict is per window against the frozen limit
the seven statuses are published separately
a negative electrical finding is published as a FAIL, never folded into an aggregate
the internal-node tables cover every flat step of every case
each flat step is observed for at least the 50 ns the task book asks for
TR-LONG carries all 26 branch columns and the shared reference on every step
the selected branch count is cross-checked as code plus one on every step
the delay attribution is measured on every emission window of the nine cases
a boundary the samples do not carry is named as unattributed, not filled in
the carried DC-R1 followup F-TR-1 is implemented: vss is a required signal
the carried DC-R1 followup F-TR-2 is closed with proof: terminals agree and the tolerance is expressible at the exported precision
the hybrid stimulus is the trace of a charged start and its log says so
the RTL reconciliation names the ledger it counts
every stray process is charged and the enforced ceiling still holds
0 existing tracked path was modified or deleted since the base
the bytes this round adds stay under the 32 MiB ceiling
every modified file this round owns is staged beside the tables it produced
nothing this round touches is a deletion
no raw answer, log, unpacked trace or executable is a tracked candidate
the shipped traces decompress byte for byte and are the traces the decks stamp
a confirmed start whose ledger row carries no trace digest is published as a gap
no credential, PDK, license or vendor absolute path string is in a tracked text file
published text is LF only
the nine run copies still equal the frozen base plus their identity block
every delivered deck stamps the contract as it is committed at HEAD
